summary: gatepay-sdk-python 99.99.1 beacons installer hostname to attacker DNS at install time
details: The sdist's setup.py executes on `pip install` and performs a DNS lookup of a subdomain constructed from an MD5 hash of the installer's hostname under the attacker-controlled parent zone `gatepay-sdk-python.depconf.zsdsh.xyz`. The lookup fires unconditionally during install, with no user interaction, exfiltrating a per-host identifier to whoever operates that DNS zone and enabling enumeration of every environment where the package resolves. The version number (99.99.1) and name shape are consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal package. The README's claim that no data is exfiltrated contradicts the observed behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
